scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w services/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w services/api

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w services/api
